role: Mobile-first continuous execution projection over the existing Dayline DayState. One source-linked object may remain held through RUN → WITNESS → COMPLETE → RETURN, then Dayline releases completed focus only after emitting one OFFER_ONLY receipt to the exact native source.
authority: NONE / projection + explicit local DayState mutation only
preserves: manual Dayline time + explicit device clock witness
source SHA/signal/message/range identity for COMMS return offers

validation.closed_loop: RUN → WITNESS → COMPLETE → RETURN → OFFER_ONLY → native explicit accept

stop: Functional correctness is machine/browser verified first. Real-world completion remains a WORLD claim; phone preference/ergonomics is optional subjective evidence, not the default promotion gate.

world_only: whether an intended real-world action was actually performed
